title: Chinantecan languages - Wikipedia
text: The Chinantec or Chinantecan languages constitute a branch of the Oto-Manguean family. Though traditionally considered a single language, Ethnologue lists 14 partially mutually unintelligible varieties of Chinantec.

text: Sochiapam Chinantec is a stable indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Otomanguean language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
